cards.title: CONCEPT
cards.text: 43.70-second Resolve ad, aligned to the selected permitted reference-voice clone. Original HeyGen presenter, Google Omni motion and distinct corrected wardrobe stills. Exact approved narration preserved. These 13 images are actual first frames from the Natural / Avatar V export; the separate reference lane remains source evidence. Picture ends with the narration; extra hold removed.

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Nobody does it
Haaland seated beside a private jet; black designer bag immediately visible. Large hook presenter and red/white title.

cards.title: EMOTION

Recognition and desire: the bag already belongs to an aspirational full outfit.

Start on the photo without a fade. Direct cut mid-hook at “like”; the second distinct photo turns recognition into a collection impression.

cards.title: EMOTION

Direct cut in and out. Hold title across the cut so only the underlying photograph changes. No added pan or whoosh.
S03 · 2.27–6.60s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: The guy turns up carrying a Birkin, and the bag is the first thing you notice.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Style attention: let the viewer find the bag within a simple outfit before introducing the buying option.

Direct cut on “The guy.” Hold the outfit through the sentence; complete picture change at “If you want” separates Haaland from Velantra.
S04 · 6.60–11.63s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: If you want a travel bag with that kind of presence, take a look at the Velantra Weekender.
Airport outfit with the Cognac Weekender; restrained step and head turn. Correct paired front straps and rolled handles.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Product discovery: connect the desired presence to the actual named product and an attainable outfit.

Direct cut on the spoken cue. Selected restrained Google Omni motion preserves product visibility. Product discovery: connect the desired presence to the actual named product and an attainable outfit.
S05 · 11.63–17.53s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: It’s got a broad, rectangular shape, rolled leather handles, and a leather flap over canvas.
Stacked product front and handle close-up; warm canvas, leather flap and horizontal oval hardware visible.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Visual evidence: the front demonstrates shape while the separate detail makes the rolled handle construction legible.

Direct cut to two distinct simultaneous product views: front for silhouette/flap/canvas, detail for rolled handles. Hold through the named features.
S06 · 17.53–21.67s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: So even with a plain T-shirt and jeans, it gives you a sharper look.
Distinct white T-shirt and jeans outfit still with corrected Cognac Weekender. Omni generation failed; inspected still selected.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Visible payoff: show how the bag changes a familiar outfit immediately after explaining its construction.

Direct cut on the casual-outfit payoff. Inspected corrected still retained after two failed Omni requests; no repeated source clip.
S07 · 21.67–26.83s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: The Cognac version has brown leather against a lighter canvas body, with gold-tone hardware.
Moving close-up of Cognac leather, light canvas and gold-tone hardware; hand lightly traces leather.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Tactile desire: make the color contrast and finishing visible before showing wardrobe combinations.

Direct cut on “The Cognac version.” Hold through the named materials; favor the gold plate at “hardware.” Keep captions and presenter clear of the features.
S08 · 26.83–29.10s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Easy to wear with a navy jacket,
A man in a navy blazer and grey trousers steps from a stone doorway carrying the Weekender.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Outfit compatibility: make the first named pairing concrete rather than leaving “easy to wear” as an abstract claim.

Direct cut on “Easy to wear.” Quick wardrobe cadence begins here; no transition animation. Cut at the next named outfit.
S09 · 29.10–29.77s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: denim,
A younger man in a dark denim jacket sets the Weekender on a station bench.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Range: a different age, setting, action and composition make the casual pairing a distinct scene.

Direct cut at “denim.” Preserve a readable bag and outfit; later motion is the small set-down only. Cut on “or.”
S10 · 29.77–31.37s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: or a black coat.
A dark-haired man in a black overcoat and grey trousers walks beside a modern building with the Weekender.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Range completed: the lighter canvas stands out against the dark outfit, closing the three-pairing sequence.

Direct cut on “or a black coat.” End the faster wardrobe run at the end of the sentence, then slow for the interior demonstration.
S11 · 31.37–36.20s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: Inside, there’s a wide slip pocket to keep smaller things separate from the main compartment.
Actual owner-shot footage of the Cognac Weekender opening and its wide slip pocket. Original phone clip IMG_4051.MOV,8.50–13.33s; no generated zipper.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Supporting utility: show the one evidenced organization detail after the style-led argument.

Direct cut on Inside; opening action completes as the slip pocket is named. Original phone footage shows actual caramel lining and pocket. Caption above, presenter below the bag opening.
S12 · 36.20–40.47s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: So you’ve got a bag for the weekend that looks right when you walk into the hotel, too.
Hotel entrance outfit with the Cognac Weekender; restrained settling step and head turn.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Imagined use: finish on arriving well dressed, making weekend function support the appearance payoff.

Direct cut on the spoken cue. Selected restrained Google Omni motion preserves product visibility. Imagined use: finish on arriving well dressed, making weekend function support the appearance payoff.
S13 · 40.47–43.70s · voice aligned

cards.title: SCRIPT
cards.text: The Velantra Weekender. Check it out at the link below.
Clean Cognac Weekender hero on the stone ledge with blurred skyline; bag and background only.

cards.title: EMOTION
cards.text:
Product focus: end on the bag alone so its silhouette and materials carry the final impression; narration supplies the brand and link instruction.

Direct cut on final product name. Bag only, no presenter or text. Full spoken CTA; picture ends with narration at43.70seconds. No extra hold.

cards.text: NOTES

cards.title: VOICE — SELECTED / HEYGEN
cards.text: User confirmed speaker permission and lawful use in this conversation. Fresh permitted reference clone; Eleven v3 Natural0.5 drives the original HeyGen presenter. Narration remains at original speed; final export audio has zero measured offset. Three rendered lip-sync windows checked.

cards.title: EDIT LANGUAGE
cards.text: Direct picture cuts on ideas; fast athlete opening and three-item wardrobe run, longer product and pocket holds. Continuous microphone presenter. Compact uppercase white phrase captions on black bars. Red/white hook title; occasional stacked detail and blur fill when source framing needs it. No universal zoom or whoosh.

cards.title: AUDIO / ALIGNMENT
cards.text: Selected original-speed Eleven v3 Natural narration drives all cuts and31phrase captions. Speech-only mix. Full spoken CTA preserved; picture and narration tracks end together at43.70seconds. No added end hold.

cards.title: PRODUCT / SOURCE PROVENANCE
cards.text: Cognac canvas body, brown leather upper/flap/rolled handles/corners, horizontal oval gold-tone plate and caramel interior with wide slip pocket. Product construction checked against actual references. Generated lifestyle scale is illustrative, not measured. Haaland photos came from the existing concept’s sourced plates; no endorsement or commercial rights verification is implied.

cards.title: STORYBOARD QA / NEXT PRODUCTION
cards.text: Inspect every selected image for bag geometry, hardware, pocket visibility, typography and composition variety. Keep reference lane separate. Generated stills establish proposed scenes; motion and voice are not rendered. Use Google Omni for later motion and an isolated DaVinci Resolve timeline for assembly, final caption alignment and playback QA.
